mapper.select: SELECT id AS operator_id, password_hash FROM operator WHERE NOT deleted AND status = 'active' AND account = #{account}
SELECT id AS operator_id, account, display_name, region, version FROM operator WHERE NOT deleted AND status = 'active' AND id = #{operatorId}
SELECT id AS operator_id, account, password_hash FROM operator WHERE NOT deleted AND status = 'active' AND id = #{operatorId}
SELECT id, account, display_name, region, status, created_at FROM operator WHERE NOT deleted ORDER BY account
SELECT id, account, display_name, region, status, created_at FROM operator WHERE NOT deleted AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operator (id, account, display_name, password_hash, region, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{account}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{region}, 'active', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (account) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE operator SET display_name = #{displayName}, region = #{region}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE operator SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> #{status} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE operator SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: UPDATE operator SET version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted RETURNING version
